_comment: What is already in each piece of labware when the run starts, so the run map can show which wells are filled and the liquid pages can tell when a stock runs dry. Keys are either a tracked plate's starting location (same keys as plates.json) or '<node>:<deck slot>' for a reservoir that never moves. 'wells' takes a single well (A6), a rectangular range (A1:H8) or a comma-separated list. volume_ul is what each of those wells holds at the start: the simulated consumption over 3 rounds plus dead volume, so these are PROPOSED loading volumes, not measured ones. capacity_ul is the labware's well capacity, checked against volume_ul. expected_dry lists wells the run deliberately draws from when empty, so a genuine shortfall still stands out.
